display.purpose: The hero name only; letters rise in on load.

headline.purpose: Section titles (h2), balanced, max 20ch; Contacto steps up to clamp(2.5rem, 1.45rem + 3.8vw, 5rem).

hook.purpose: The hero question line, closing on a script phrase.

card-title.purpose: Service tiles, hang tags (1.375rem) and the brief card (1.5rem); lead service tile 2.5rem on desktop.

script.purpose: Dani's own phrases only, rotated -3 to -5deg, written in by a clip reveal.

body.purpose: Running text; copy columns cap at 46 to 58ch.

intro.purpose: Paragraph under a section title, in the fabric's ink-2.

label.purpose: Tracked caps inside stickers, the ficha "Ideal para", the chat-preview label and the cinta (up to .8125rem, .16em).

motion.name: stitch-sew

motion.name: script-write

motion.name: photo-zoom
motion.purpose: Photo zoom on hover (1.03 spreads, 1.05 service tiles).

motion.name: retazos-transition

motion.name: like-pop

motion.name: tag-swing
motion.purpose: Hang tag swing on hover or tap.

motion.name: look-drift

motion.name: cinta-marquee

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions off; no particles or autoplay; script always visible. Save-Data also skips the three.js bundle.

narrative.northStar: La colcha de Negros a Blancos
narrative.overview:
The page is one quilt. Every section is a retazo of a different fabric, sewn to the next with a dashed seam, and the fabric order runs from the black of Día de Negros to the talco white of Día de Blancos. Three materials are treated as one: the patchwork fields of Nariño, the comparsa vest and a fashion designer's cloth. The finish is fashion-editorial. Bodoni Moda sits large and quiet on deep negro, and the photography (studio portraits, comparsa, Srta. Nariño Bambuco 2025, production BTS) carries the content.

Dani's own collage is the voice on top. It shows up as carmín Yellowtail script for her phrases, red halftone stickers (star, lips, headphones) on die-cut papel, and dotted oval speech bubbles. Patches stay square and stitched, and only the pill actions, the oval cameo and the bubbles are round. Motion is the Carnaval in the air: talco and confeti particles, a portrait that breaks into fabric patches between looks, stickers that bob and can be dragged, hang tags that swing. All of it stops under one pause control and is gone under reduced motion.

The system rejects the influencer canon (white page, serif name over a full-bleed portrait, a grey logo row) and the generic fiesta collage of a Carnaval site.
keyCharacteristics: Whole sections are fabrics. Each one sets its own ink, secondary ink, thread and script ink.
Dashed 1.5px stitches stand in for borders: section seams, inset tile frames, the active-link underline.
Corners are square for patches and tiles. Round is kept for pills, ovals and bubbles.
Bodoni Moda with optical size tuned per role, Figtree for text, Yellowtail only for Dani's voice.
Carmín is the single action and voice color. Retazo colors are fabric and patches.
Shadows are soft and negro-tinted with negative spread. Paper and stickers lift; nothing is hard-offset.

rules.name: The Fabric Variables Rule
rules.body: A section declares `--fabric`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--thread` and, on dark grounds, `--script-ink`. Components read those variables and never hard-code text color, so any component can sit on any retazo.

rules.name: The Carmín Means Action Rule
rules.body: Carmín is reserved for the call to action, Dani's script, her stickers and the cinta. It is never a section fabric and never decoration on its own.

rules.name: The Patch-Only Rule
rules.body: Cobalto and naranja appear only at patch scale (bullets, tabs, step numbers, confeti). A whole surface in either breaks the colcha's palette.

rules.name: The Her Voice Rule
rules.body: Yellowtail is set only on Dani's own phrases ("Yo te ayudo.", "pero dime Dani.", "barbie marketera", "¿Indecis@?", the next-patch invitations). It is rotated -3 to -5deg, it writes itself in with a clip reveal on entry, and it is always fully visible under reduced motion. It never sets navigation, body or buttons.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Bodoni's `opsz` follows the role: 80 for the name, 40 for h2, 32–36 for the hook and the menu sheet, 24–28 for card titles and the wordmark. Never let a small Bodoni render at display optical size.

rules.name: The Caps Live In Lockups Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps appear only inside stickers, labels and the cinta. They never sit above a title as a kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow means a physical object above the fabric, so it is always blurred and spread inward. Hard offset shadows are not part of this world.

dos: **Do** give every new section a fabric from the palette and set its `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--thread` (and `--script-ink` on negro) together, then seam it to its neighbor with the 1.5px dashed stitch.
**Do** frame tiles, cards and photos with a dashed stitch inset 5–8px, and keep their corners square.
**Do** use the carmín pompón pill (52px, 999px, inset dashed stitch) for every WhatsApp action, with carmín hondo on hover.
**Do** lower Bodoni's optical size as size drops (80, 40, 32, 24).

**Do** use the shared ease-out `cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)` for reveals, lifts and sheets. Route all hero motion through the single pause control, and drop particles, autoplay, bob and marquee under reduced motion or Save-Data.
**Do** keep each section's ink-2 on its own fabric. These inks were tuned per ground.
donts: **Don't** set Yellowtail on anything that isn't Dani's own phrase: no nav, buttons, body or labels.
**Don't** place tracked caps above a title as a kicker or eyebrow. Caps live inside stickers, labels and the cinta.
**Don't** use cobalto or naranja as a section fabric or large surface.
**Don't** use carmín as a fabric or as decoration away from an action, script or sticker.
**Don't** run logos as a grey strip. Client logos keep their own colors on their own stitched talco tiles, and UGC marks are negro on stitched cebada tiles.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows. Lift is always a soft, inward-spread blur.
**Don't** round tiles, cards or patches. Round is only for pills, ovals, icon controls and the single chat bubble.
